context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features verified end-to-end on https://lavanet-pro.preview.emergentagent.com. Detailed results: (1) MODO TURNO: /turno renders turno-page with all 7 stage columns (Recibida, Clasificación, En lavado, En secado, Planchado, Control de calidad, Lista para entregar). 19 seeded cards present. Clicking turno-advance-ORD-1019 moved the card from turno-col-Recibida to turno-col-Clasificación (verified via DOM traversal). turno-scope-mi and turno-scope-todas both visible for admin. (2) LOYALTY — Clientes: 'Puntos' column present with amber badges (e.g., Ana 816 pts, Rosa 777 pts). Detail modal shows 'PUNTOS DE FIDELIDAD' card in amber with S/ equivalence (816 pts ≈ S/ 40.80). Note: text is CSS-uppercased so use case-insensitive contains for assertions. (3) LOYALTY — POS: selecting Rosa Quispe displays pos-customer-points='699 pts' (already reduced by earlier redemptions in the seeded run — retro-migration works). Adding 2 services set pos-total=S/ 15.93; entering 100 in pos-points-redeem lowered pos-total to S/ 10.03 (100 pts = S/5 discount pre-IGV; 15.93/1.18 - 5 = 8.50; 8.50*1.18 = 10.03 — math correct). pos-points-max button present. (4) WHATSAPP: In Ordenes detail modal after clicking timeline-'Lista para entregar', whatsapp-notify anchor appears with href='https://wa.me/51911223344?text=Hola%20Diego...ORD-1022...'. In /entregas each ready-to-deliver row exposes whatsapp-<ORD> (whatsapp-ORD-1025, whatsapp-ORD-1022) with valid wa.me/51 hrefs including order number in text. (5) REPORTES: reportes-export-csv triggers download 'LAVANET_reporte_2026-07-11_a_2026-08-10.csv' (matches prefix/suffix requirement). reportes-print-pdf invokes window.print() (verified via override) and #print-report DOM node exists with content 'Reporte de Ventas'. (6) Regression: dashboard, POS quick create, Ordenes list, Entregas confirm-delivery UI (entregar-ORD-1025 present) all functional. Minor a11y warnings only. No functional defects found. Consider clearing localStorage before re-runs if you need to observe the retro-migration effect fresh.
